hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/cherry-springs-state-park/stay ('The rustic campground has 30 non-electric campsites') + ReserveAmerica catalog for parkId 880143 (all sites Rustic Tent or Rustic Non-Electric), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/cherry-springs-state-park/stay ('non-flush restrooms, and a sanitary dump station'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR says 30 non-electric campsites; the booking site lists 29 (18 Rustic Tent, 11 Rustic Non-Electric) in the Airport A and B campgrounds, two of the tent sites walk-to. Listed max vehicle lengths run 18 to 80 ft; Airport B sites 026-030 are 80-ft pull-throughs. Pets are prohibited in the campground; red-filtered lights are recommended for the stargazers.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cherry-springs-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880143 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Site Access) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). The Overnight Astronomy Observation Field is not reservable; it is registered separately.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cherry-springs-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880143 (Booking Window for Rustic Non-Electric and Rustic Tent: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (second Friday in April to last weekend in October). Added no electric, non-flush (vault) toilets, dump station, 30 sites (29 on RA) up to 80 ft with five pull-throughs. Not stated for this park: showers, min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
